title: Bill Napier links the Younger Dryas impact to the Taurids
summary: Randall Carlson tells of Bill Napier links the Younger Dryas impact to the Taurids, about Younger Dryas, about 12,900 years ago at Astrophysical observatory, England, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I think it was from Bill Napier over in uh the astrophysical observatory in England who first proposed it could have been the um the uh the torids.
that's what those two guys think is that maybe there was a comet um air burst in the torid meteor stream
tellings.difference: Dates it c. 9,600 BC and credits Carlson and Hancock rather than Bill Napier.
tellings.link_reason: Same theory that a Taurid-stream comet impact or airburst caused the Ice Age cataclysm at the Younger Dryas.

as_told.title: Taurid comet airburst and an Ice Age cataclysm
